data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to retrieve the SIM country code using platform-specific APIs.
data.what_it_does: It accesses native platform APIs to retrieve the SIM country code. On Android, it uses TelephonyManager. On iOS, it uses either Locale or CTTelephonyNetworkInfo depending on the iOS version.
use_when: You need to retrieve the SIM card country code on Android or iOS.
You want a straightforward imperative method call to get the region ISO code.
avoid_when: You are running on iOS simulators or devices without a SIM card where it will return null.
You need deep locale or language translation management rather than just the SIM country code.
strengths: Simple API with a single main method: getSIMCountryCode.
Handles deprecated iOS APIs by falling back to Locale for iOS 16.0 and higher.
weaknesses: Returns null on iOS simulators and devices without a SIM card.
Windows and Linux support is very basic and simply returns null instead of throwing an exception.
data.setup_notes: No extra native setup or permissions are documented beyond adding the dependency.

alternatives.name: devicelocale
alternatives.why_pick_it: It provides the device locale and language settings if you need general locale information rather than strictly the SIM country code.
